text.description_html:
Fusion PH-E4, Wall Mounted Sonoma Toilet Paper Holder

Although Sonoma is often synonymous with wine, it can also be associated with rustic decor. The Sonoma Wall Mounted Toilet Paper Holder features a square mount with a classic design that is perfect for upscale-rustic spaces. Choose from either medium bronze or oil rubbed bronze. Made by Fusion, the PH-E4 comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-E4 Sonoma Towel Bar, Fusion TR-E4 Sonoma Towel Ring, and Fusion RH-E4 Sonoma Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Sonoma Trim Paper Holder:

  • Mount Length: 2-5/8" square
  • Mount Projection: 1/2"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
